snippet.title: ASTHENIA- Steam Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
This is the gameplay trailer for my first, solo game, "Asthenia".
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181660/ASTHENIA/
Join Us on Discord: https://discord.gg/FmXa5Daqtx

A dark fantasy adventure set in a world of ancient entities. Explore otherworldly decaying towns, ruins, temples, and industrial zones. Encounter the distorted inhabitants and other tortured souls. Unravel the mystery behind a war, and escape unharmed or be lost forever in the world of Asthenia.
